// Task 2 var.1: async-await on JVM target
//
// Async functions return a Task handle (an int pointing into the heap).
// The runtime helpers __await(task) and __task_complete(task, result),
// generated by the JVM backend, implement the Task pattern:
//   HEAP[task+0] = done flag, HEAP[task+1] = result.

async int compute(int a, int b) {
    return a + b + '0';
}

async int doubleIt(int x) {
    int s = await compute(x, x);
    return s;
}

int main() {
    int t1 = compute(1, 2);
    int t2 = compute(0, 4);
    int t3 = doubleIt(3);

    out(await t1);   // (1+2)+'0' = '3'
    out(await t2);   // (0+4)+'0' = '4'
    out(await t3);   // (3+3)+'0' = '6'
    out('\n');

    return 0;
}
